items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I have recorded with Prez, recorded with Lady Day.

ctx.x: I have solos. I sold with Art. I have solos. I've worked with Nat Cole, I worked with Nat Cole for 14 years. I worked with Prez, I worked with Fletcher, I -- and I mean this is a matter of record. I have recorded with Prez, recorded with Lady Day. How is this possible?
